purpose: Qualify or reject the cost-rank-1 PBE baseline using numerical convergence, Cu bulk structure and isolated CO structure/vibration only. No surface diffusion or kinetic observable is evaluated in Stage A.
forbidden_inputs: CO/Cu(111) hopping rate or diffusion coefficient

cutoff_pairs_ry.basis: maximum SSSP-efficiency recommended floor across pinned Cu/C/O bundle

bulk_cu.fit: quadratic E(a) fit over the complete frozen six-point lattice grid

physical_guard.reference: independent experimental Cu fcc lattice constant near ambient conditions
physical_guard.role: broad method-fidelity guard only; it cannot choose among numerically passing settings

bulk_cu.selection_rule: Among all nonterminal cutoff/k pairs satisfying both joint numerical criteria relative to C2/k16, choose the lowest cutoff-pair index and then the lowest k. If none passes, Stage A returns NUMERICAL_HOLD rather than extending the grid automatically.

bond_scan_angstrom.note: wide fixed scan; not centered or shifted after seeing the numerical minimum

fit.form: quartic polynomial in bond length over the seven scan points nearest the discrete numerical minimum, with the continuous minimum required to lie inside the fitted interval
fit.frequency: harmonic stretch from the second derivative of the fitted energy at the fitted minimum and the 12C-16O reduced mass
fit.discretization_check: repeat the local fit using every second point from the same fixed scan and require stretch-frequency agreement within 10 cm^-1

physical_guards.bond_reference_source: NIST CCCBDB experimental equilibrium bond length
physical_guards.interpretation_note: The calculated curvature is a harmonic frequency while 2143 cm^-1 is an experimental fundamental. The 5% gate is deliberately broad and is a method-fidelity guard, not a spectroscopic benchmark claim.

isolated_CO.selection_rule: For each cutoff pair and box, evaluate the complete fixed bond scan. A selectable cutoff/box must pass both numerical convergence criteria relative to C2/L26, the fit-discretization check, and both broad physical guards. Choose the lowest cutoff-pair index then smallest selectable box.

combined_stage_A_rule.pass: Bulk Cu and isolated CO must both PASS. The production cutoff pair becomes the stricter of the separately selected bulk and CO cutoff-pair indices; the bulk k-mesh comes from the bulk selection and the gas box is retained only for isolated-molecule calibration.
combined_stage_A_rule.post_combination_check: Re-evaluate the bulk and CO numerical criteria at the combined cutoff before declaring Stage A PASS.
